page_title: CAG 1-0 CRE | Cagliari v Cremonese 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' A loose ball is pounced on by Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Elia Caprile is alert and makes a comfortable save.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Martin Payero (Cremonese) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
89' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) replacing Juan Rodriguez.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Belotti (Cagliari) comes onto the pitch for Sebastiano Esposito.
87' Martin Payero (Cremonese) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
86' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. Cremonese get a corner.

82' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
79' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is penalised for holding. Daniele Doveri signals a set piece. Cagliari will take a free kick.
78' Here is a change. David Okereke is going off and Marco Giampaolo gives the last tactical orders to Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese).
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Milan Djuric (Cremonese) is replacing Warren Bondo.
76' Adam Obert (Cagliari) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

75' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Emil Audero shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

74' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
73' Marco Giampaolo has decided to make a change. Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) replaces Filippo Terracciano.
72' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:2.
68' Here comes a substitution. Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) is brought on as a substitute for Romano Floriani.
68' Marco Giampaolo decides to make a substitution. Jari Vandeputte will be replaced by Martin Payero (Cremonese).
67' The Cremonese players are exchanging some short passes.

63' 1 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Jose Pedro finds Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Emil Audero had no chance of stopping that. 1:0.
62' The foul by Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniele Doveri.
61' Fabio Pisacane has decided to substitute Michael Folorunsho and he is replaced by Jose Pedro (Cagliari).
61' A substitution has been made. Gennaro Borrelli goes off and Paul Mendy (Cagliari) comes on.

60' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
60' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) steps up to send the ball in.

57' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.

54' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
54' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
54' Cagliari win a corner.
53' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) attempts to send a pass but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.

49' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Doveri starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' Adam Obert (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Cagliari.
44' Cremonese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
40' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
38' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
37' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

34' Adam Obert (Cagliari) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom left corner. Emil Audero shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
33' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
32' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
31' Fabio Pisacane is forced to make a change. Luca Mazzitelli is unable to continue due to injury, Michel Adopo (Cagliari) comes on.
28' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
27' Cremonese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Warren Bondo (Cremonese) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
21' A brilliant cross into the box finds David Okereke (Cremonese), who directs his low header onto the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
21' A quickly taken corner by Cremonese.
18' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Doveri blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cagliari.
16' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
15' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) probably handled the ball. It's a free kick to Cremonese, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
11' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for David Okereke, but Elia Caprile displays great awareness to stop him.

9' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
9' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
7' Great teamplay by Cremonese as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
3' The corner from Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) is intercepted by Emil Audero.

3' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the top of the net, but the Emil Audero pulled off a nice save. The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
3' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

2' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Cagliari will take a corner kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Cremonese will take the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
